## When to use

## How to use

Read the individual reference documents for detailed explanations and code examples.

### Docs

- [API Reference: Mastra platform](references/docs-mastra-platform-api.md) - Use the Mastra platform REST API to manage members, tokens, Studio and Server deployments, gateways, observability feedback and metrics, and project-scoped resources.
- [Observability](references/docs-mastra-platform-observability-overview.md) - Collect, import, and query hosted traces, logs, metrics, scores, and feedback from Mastra applications with Mastra Platform Observability and local fallback storage.
